info.name: Azure Monitor Azure Application Insights API
Azure Monitor Execute an Application Insights query via GET

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: query
params.description: The Analytics query in KQL format.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query data in ISO 8601 duration format.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics query against Application Insights data using Kusto Query Language (KQL). The query is provided as a query parameter.

info.name: Azure Monitor Execute an Application Insights query via POST

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

items.docs: Executes an Analytics query against Application Insights data using Kusto Query Language (KQL). The query is provided in the request body.

info.name: Azure Monitor Get an Application Insights metric

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: metricId
params.description: ID of the metric. Standard metrics include requests/count, requests/duration, dependencies/count, exceptions/count, etc.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query in ISO 8601 duration format.

params.name: interval
params.description: The time interval to use when retrieving metric values.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: The aggregation to use when computing the metric values.

params.name: segment
params.description: The name of the dimension to segment the metric values by.

params.name: top
params.description: The number of segments to return.

params.name: orderby
params.description: The aggregation function and direction to sort the segments by.

params.name: filter
params.description: An expression to filter the results.

items.docs: Gets metric values for a single Application Insights metric. Returns aggregated metric data for the specified timespan and interval.

info.name: Azure Monitor Get multiple Application Insights metrics

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

items.docs: Gets metric values for multiple Application Insights metrics in a single request.

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

items.docs: Gets metadata describing the available metrics for the Application Insights component.

info.name: Azure Monitor Get events by type

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: eventType
params.description: The type of events to query.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query in ISO 8601 duration format.

params.name: $filter
params.description: An expression used to filter the returned events.

params.name: $search
params.description: A free-text search expression to match for whether a particular event should be returned.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: A comma-separated list of properties with asc or desc to sort on.

params.name: $select
params.description: Limits the properties returned for each event.

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of items to skip over before returning events.

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of events to return.

params.name: $format
params.description: Format for the returned events.

params.name: $count
params.description: Request a count of matching items included with the returned events.

params.name: $apply
params.description: An expression used for aggregation over returned events.

items.docs: Gets the results of an OData query for events of a specific type from Application Insights telemetry.

info.name: Azure Monitor Get a single event

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: eventType
params.description: The type of events to query.

params.name: eventId
params.description: The ID of the event.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query.

items.docs: Gets the data for a single event from Application Insights telemetry.
